title: Kidney-function–phosphate coupling does not establish incremental PTH prediction across two NHANES recruitment cycles
abstract: A standardized eGFR × phosphate product did not establish improved contemporaneous logPTH prediction beyond nonlinear conventional measures in exploratory NHANES2003–2004 to2005–2006 transfer (3,772 source;3,781 target adults): weighted MSE difference 0.000155999 logPTH², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.00100999,0.00262912].
